bypass.finding: No production caller. Only tests pass it: nfl/tests/test_pool_entries_separation.py:88, test_roster_reserve_absent.py:41, test_classic_slate_state.py:43, test_sunday_prelock_p0.py:36, test_role_depth_adversarial.py:210, test_showdown_identity_paths.py:84, test_roster_eligibility_contract.py:196,269, test_pit_fail_closed.py:88,93. Production entry points call build without it (classic_slate_state.py:595, showdown_tonight.py:177-178, showdown_slate_state.py:621).

A pit_exempt Showdown state is refused only at the default OUT path; it can be written into a scenario directory, and --portfolio-only rebuilds portfolios from a scenario without checking point_in_time.mode. Needs a direct SSS.build(pit_exempt=...) call; no production code does that. No receipt is written, so showdown_next_slate cannot finalize it.

Only NFL_PIT_MANIFEST activates the contract (point_in_time.py:47,412-420; nfl/__init__.py:6-8); no variable disables it. NFL_PIT_TRACE only traces. Unset = live mode, which still runs the state-builder gate.

Live-mode gate scope: only guarded captures and TEAM_GAME are clock-checked. A replay in a worktree where post-cutoff captures were removed (the practice point_in_time.py:12-13 describes) passes while reading today's nfl/derived panel, nfl/sim fitted models (DST_MODEL fit on 2026 pbp), MARKET_VOLUME, participation tables, snap counts and explicit inputs.

Classic as_of is unbounded: as_of >= now passes the live gate and is stamped LIVE_VERIFIED; no as_of <= kickoff check (Showdown clamps, showdown_slate_state.py:315). classic_release blocks only on wall-clock portfolio build time (349-356).

_kicker_rates catches Exception around kicker_model.measure -> sources.select -> PIT.admit/hook, so PITUnauthorizedRead or PIT_ADMITTED_FILE_CHANGED becomes KICKER_RATES_ABSENT kickers (dk_points None) instead of a refusal. Other handlers: sources.py:169 (candidate marked UNREADABLE; low, admit runs outside the try at 253), classic_slate_run.py:370 and showdown_slate_run.py:145 (PITError is a RuntimeError; converted to a FAIL with a non-PIT code, still fail closed), showdown_next_slate.py:379-381,394 (UNDETERMINED/UNVERIFIED, never PASS), pool_audit.py:89-92 (constant import only).

Hook blind spots under a manifest: files in subdirectories of guarded roots or with non-content-id names; nfl/derived non-.json; nfl/sim subdirs; all explicit_inputs (pins never checked on open); every root outside GUARDED (nfl/availability_raw, nfl/research/*, nfl/dfs/*, nfl/warehouse/* except TEAM_GAME); paths outside the repo or reached through a symlink; reads done by subprocesses that do not import nfl.

No cross-stage binding: downstream stages never call require_point_in_time or compare the state's point_in_time.seal with the active manifest, and draws/book/seal/receipt do not record it. Stages run by hand with a different or no NFL_PIT_MANIFEST read derived/fitted files unpinned without any refusal.

Derived/fitted pins are declared hashes; nothing proves the pinned bytes were built from captures admitted at the cutoff (e.g. compare a pinned artifact's _lineage inputs with manifest.admitted). nfl/derived is uncommitted, so pinned bytes cannot be recovered from git.
No nfl/sim pins, so a sealed ATL_NO replay now stops at the first nfl/sim open with PIT_FITTED_UNPINNED (derived from code, not run). Not a leak; a replay blocker.

Readers that glob guarded roots without PIT.admit. Under a manifest they fail closed (PIT_UNAUTHORIZED_READ) rather than leak; in live mode the gate covers them. Not a bypass; they block sealed replays of the book, kicker selection and audit stages.
The Classic run rewrites the pinned nfl/derived/DST_RATES.json (Showdown redirects it, showdown_slate_run.py:102). The production run mutates a pinned cache.
The receipt environment fingerprint keeps only SHOWDOWN_* keys, so NFL_PIT_MANIFEST is not bound into the receipt.
